title: 4‑BR 30A Beach Vacation Home with Golf Cart & Communal Pool
meta_description: A Serene Stay on 30A, a 4-BR, 4.5-bath luxury beach house with a community pool, golf cart, and outdoor grill. Accommodates 15 guests.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Serene Stay on 30A
normalized_matching_profile.description: Escape to 'Serene Stay on 30A,' located in the tranquil community of Serenity at Dune Allen. This stunning, brand new 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home offers the ultimate beach retreat. Bright, spacious, and elegantly furnished with luxury amenities and decor, it provides a serene escape over 3 levels.Step into the open-concept layout, where the beautiful kitchen takes center stage, complete with an island and seating for 5. Gather around the dining table that comfortably accommodates 8 for family meals. The generously sized living area provides plenty of seating with 2 cozy couches and chairs, making it an ideal space for relaxation and bonding.The 1st-floor master suite is complete with a king-size bed, an ensuite bathroom with a dual vanity and walk-in shower. On the 2nd floor, you'll find the 2nd master bedroom, a king suite with an ensuite bathroom boasting a dual vanity and walk-in shower. Additional accommodations on the 2nd floor include a king suite with an ensuite bathroom and a single vanity. Perfect for the younger guests, the 2nd floor also offers hall bunks. Up on the 3rd floor, you'll find a bunk room with full-over-full bunks and an additional twin bed. This floor also features a bathroom with a convenient tub/shower combo.For a bit of fun and entertainment, head to the game room, fully equipped with a foosball table and a TV, making it a perfect hangout spot. When you're ready for some fresh air, step out onto the screened-in porch, complete with a gas grill for barbecue evenings. With comfortable seating and an outdoor TV, it's also a perfect place for unwinding and enjoying the great outdoors.You're just 0.3 miles away from the Dune Allen Regional Beach Access. Plus, for those days when you want a change of scenery, the large community pool is a fantastic alternative for relaxing under the Florida sun. For added convenience, a golf cart is at your disposal, ensuring your beach days are a breeze.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King suite with ensuite bathroom, dual vanity and walk-in shower (master 1).2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: King suite with ensuite bathroom, dual vanity and walk-in shower (master 2).2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King suite with ensuite bathroom, single vanity and walk-in shower.2nd floor landing: Full-over-full bunk beds.3rd floor, Bedroom 4: Full-over-full bunks + twin bed. Hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.Beach Access:Head down Serene Way to Charming Way and keep walking until you reach your beach access, Dune Allen Regional Beach Access.Distance: .3 miles | Time: 8 minutes walkingSerenity at Dune Allen:Located on the quieter, western end of 30A, Serenity at Dune Allen embodies coastal tranquility. This charming neighborhood seamlessly links you to the area's diverse culinary delights, unique boutique shopping, scenic cycling paths, and extensive golf courses. Conveniently connected to Highway 98, you can effortlessly explore nearby gems like Destin and Panama City Beach, all while enjoying proximity to the Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport. This is the perfect place to discover the serene side of the Emerald Coast.Your stay at Serene Stay on 30A comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 2 cars.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
